title: Long topic in the sessions list runs into the voice count
where: /admin (sessions list), 1440x900, a topic longer than the row
what_happens: The truncated topic ends '…play in s...' directly against '3 voices' with no space between them.
who_hurts: Admins scanning the list read the count as part of the title.
suggested_fix: Add a gap between the two sides of the row (gap-4 on the Link's flex), session-row.tsx:26.
